headline: German Industrial Strikes Spread as Union Calls 23,000 Workers to Walk Out
summary: Industrial strikes across Germany widened after labor union IG Metall called on 23,000 workers to initiate walkouts. The expanded labor actions affect multiple manufacturing operations across the country.
why: IG Metall is Germany's largest industrial trade union, representing workers in manufacturing, metallurgy, and automotive plants. Nationwide industrial walkouts can restrict output and disrupt European industrial supply chains.
